description: The overall average option volume ratio is the plain average of the option volume ratio across every sentiment snapshot.

b.request: Link sentiment snapshots to transaction records and their associated traders via inner joins, calculate average option volume ratio per (transaction, trader type) pair, compute each pair's deviation from the overall mean optvolrt across all sentiment snapshots, retain within each trader type only pairs exceeding that type's mean deviation, and report for each trader type the mean optvolrt, mean deviation, and mean excess of retained pairs.
b.sql: WITH sentiment_trans_trader AS (SELECT sf.sentreg, sf.transref, tr.trdref, t.tradekind, sf.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), pair_avg AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt FROM sentiment_trans_trader GROUP BY transref, tradekind), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as global_mean FROM sentimentandfundamentals), pair_deviation AS (SELECT pa.transref, pa.tradekind, pa.avg_optvolrt, (pa.avg_optvolrt - os.global_mean) as deviation FROM pair_avg pa CROSS JOIN overall_stats os), type_deviation_stats AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) as mean_deviation FROM pair_deviation GROUP BY tradekind), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT pd.transref, pd.tradekind, pd.avg_optvolrt, pd.deviation, tds.mean_deviation as type_mean_deviation FROM pair_deviation pd INNER JOIN type_deviation_stats tds ON pd.tradekind = tds.tradekind WHERE pd.deviation > tds.mean_deviation) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) as mean_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) as mean_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_mean_deviation) as mean_excess FROM filtered_pairs GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind
b.raw: Link sentiment snapshots to transaction records and their associated traders via inner joins, calculate average option volume ratio per (transaction, trader type) pair, compute each pair's deviation from the overall mean optvolrt across all sentiment snapshots, retain within each trader type only pairs exceeding that type's mean deviation, and report for each trader type the mean optvolrt, mean deviation, and mean excess of retained pairs.

a.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and to that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), dropping snapshots without both matches. For each combination of transaction reference (`transref`) and trader type (`tradekind`), compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`). Take as the baseline the plain average of `optvolrt` over all sentiment snapshots, including those without a matching transaction or trader. Each combination's deviation is its average minus the baseline (no rows if the baseline is missing). Within each trader type, average those deviations. Keep only the combinations whose deviation is above their trader type's average deviation, and give each one an excess: its deviation minus the type's average deviation. Combinations with no trader type get a deviation too but are dropped at this comparison. Finally, for each trader type, report the type, the average of the kept combinations' average option volume ratios, the average of their deviations, and the average of their excess. Averages ignore missing values. No rounding.
a.sql:
WITH all_optvolrt AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as baseline
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
linked_snapshots AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.sentreg,
    sf.transref,
    sf.optvolrt,
    tr.tradekind
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
combos AS (
  SELECT 
    ls.transref,
    ls.tradekind,
    AVG(ls.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM linked_snapshots ls
  GROUP BY ls.transref, ls.tradekind
),
with_deviation AS (
  SELECT 
    combos.transref,
    combos.tradekind,
    combos.avg_optvolrt,
    aov.baseline,
    combos.avg_optvolrt - aov.baseline as deviation
  FROM combos
  CROSS JOIN all_optvolrt aov
  WHERE aov.baseline IS NOT NULL
),
type_avg_deviation AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation
  FROM with_deviation
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered_combos AS (
  SELECT 
    wd.tradekind,
    wd.avg_optvolrt,
    wd.deviation,
    (wd.deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation) as excess
  FROM with_deviation wd
  INNER JOIN type_avg_deviation tad ON wd.tradekind = tad.tradekind
  WHERE wd.deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt,
    AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation,
    AVG(excess) as avg_excess
  FROM filtered_combos
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  avg_optvolrt,
  avg_deviation,
  avg_excess
FROM final_result

c.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches, and compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) for each transaction reference and trader type (`tradekind`) pair. Measure each pair's deviation from the overall average option volume ratio (no rows if that's missing). Then, within each trader type, keep only the pairs whose deviation beats the type's average deviation, and note by how much (pairs with no trader type drop out at this step). For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, the average deviation and the average excess of those pairs? Averages ignore missing values. Don't round. The overall average option volume ratio is the plain average of the option volume ratio across every sentiment snapshot.
c.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as overall_avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  WHERE sf.optvolrt IS NOT NULL
    AND sf.transref IS NOT NULL
    AND t.tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
pairs_with_deviation AS (
  SELECT 
    p.transref,
    p.tradekind,
    p.avg_optvolrt,
    p.avg_optvolrt - oa.overall_avg_optvolrt as deviation
  FROM pairs p
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(ABS(deviation)) as avg_abs_deviation_by_type
  FROM pairs_with_deviation
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pwd.tradekind,
    pwd.avg_optvolrt,
    pwd.deviation,
    ts.avg_abs_deviation_by_type - ABS(pwd.deviation) as excess
  FROM pairs_with_deviation pwd
  INNER JOIN type_stats ts ON pwd.tradekind = ts.tradekind
  WHERE ABS(pwd.deviation) < ts.avg_abs_deviation_by_type
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt_for_type,
  AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation_for_type,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess_for_type
FROM filtered_pairs
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind

d.request: For each (transaction reference, trader type) pair, compute the mean option volume ratio and its absolute deviation from the overall average optvolrt (the simple arithmetic mean of all optvolrt values across sentiment snapshots); within each trader type, retain pairs whose absolute deviation is less than the trader type's mean absolute deviation, calculating excess for each pair as the trader type's mean absolute deviation minus that pair's absolute deviation; report per trader type the mean option volume ratio, mean absolute deviation, and mean excess of retained pairs, with averages ignoring missing values.
d.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.optvolrt) as overall_avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  WHERE s.optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
pair_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    s.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) as mean_optvolrt,
    ABS(AVG(s.optvolrt) - oa.overall_avg_optvolrt) as abs_dev_from_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE s.optvolrt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind, oa.overall_avg_optvolrt
),
trader_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(abs_dev_from_avg) as trader_type_mean_abs_dev
  FROM pair_metrics
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pm.transref,
    pm.tradekind,
    pm.mean_optvolrt,
    pm.abs_dev_from_avg,
    tts.trader_type_mean_abs_dev,
    tts.trader_type_mean_abs_dev - pm.abs_dev_from_avg as excess
  FROM pair_metrics pm
  JOIN trader_type_stats tts ON pm.tradekind = tts.tradekind
  WHERE pm.abs_dev_from_avg < tts.trader_type_mean_abs_dev
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(mean_optvolrt) as mean_option_volume_ratio,
  AVG(abs_dev_from_avg) as mean_absolute_deviation,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM filtered_pairs
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind
